## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so paid customers do not receive reminder emails. Router splitting is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
ES: `http://localhost:9200`, `orders_v1`, `orders_v2`, alias `orders`; each index has 18,432 documents. CI label is `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded and hangs. Do not edit `tests/conftest.py` without posting its diff in `#ledgerly-tests` and receiving `@mira` approval. No new `ledgerly/tasks/` Celery tasks until Locust reaches ≥400 successful executions/sec with zero timeouts.

## Ruled-out approaches
Five webhook retries duplicated customer emails. Popping events before persistence loses retries; shared `batch` references retain completed events. Retrying all HTTP errors is ruled out because 4xx errors must fail immediately.

## Plan and progress
Dunning fix pending. Next: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`. ES reindex creation, reindexing, and count verification are done; alias swap and validation remain pending. Keep commits small.

## Recent work
Webhook transport/server retries were implemented with bounded backoff; focused tests pass (8), full suite passes (44), and Ruff passes. Search indexing baseline: 18 passed, 2 failed because rebuilt documents miss recently updated invoice descriptions; per-page invoice queries and sequential embedding serialization were identified as likely bottlenecks.
